name: marquee
title: Marquee
description: Items scroll sideways in an endless loop and pause on hover or focus. Static under reduced motion.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the list, e.g. "Customers".

a11y.text: The loop pauses while the pointer is over it or focus is inside it. The second copy of the items is inert and aria-hidden, so Tab never visits it twice.
The container is a region named by label (for example Customers). Only the first copy of the items is exposed to screen readers.
Under reduced motion the loop stops, the second copy is hidden, the edge fade is removed and the items wrap onto lines.
